h: Torah and Holy Eating Extend Sacred Time Into Daily Life

p: After the section of the festivals
is written the section of the lamps
and the section of the Showbread.
about the section of the lamps,
why it was placed next to the section of the festivals.
But after it mentioned the section of the festivals,
there comes next to them the section of the lamps,
and the section of the Showbread,
of which it is written "before Hashem continually" (Vayikra 24:8):
Now the holiness of the festivals
as is written in the holy Zohar
that is, Chochmah, which is called holy;
and Torah she'b'al peh lower holiness
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רצז, א)
are likened to Shabbosos and Yom Tov
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג כט, ב)
that is, that they are always free for Torah.
And about this the section of the lamps is stated:
And oil too alludes to wisdom,
as they said in the Gemara (Menachos 85b).
"That they take to you oil, etc.":
that although the main drawing down
עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
is through Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who is the groomsman of the King,
who is the groomsman of the Matronisa,
as is written in the holy Zohar
And this is the holiness of the festivals,
"Divide it: half for Hashem and half for you"
is that the eating be in holiness,
as they said in the Gemara (Pesachim 68b):
'And you shall call Shabbos a delight.'"
That is, that the body's pleasure too
And this is the matter of the table of kings;
וְלָזֶה זָכָה שְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him, merited,
that his meal is written in words of Torah
"And do not crave the table of kings, etc."
will not crave the table of kings.
that one can eat in holiness
"For your table is greater than their table,"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
is from a supernal, precious place,
רַק עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
only through Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who is the root of the souls of Yisrael,
as is written in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 13):
Rather, he was there from the inner side:
this one from the body and this one from the soul."
That is: Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
fathered all the bodies of Yisrael,
and Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
is the root of the souls of all Yisrael,
שֶׁהוּא נֵר ה׳ נִשְׁמַת אָדָם (מִשְׁלֵי כ, כז)
which is "the lamp of Hashem, the soul of man" (Mishlei 20:27):
for the root of each Jew
is a letter or part of a letter
and Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
is the whole of the words of Torah.
שֶׁהַכֹּל עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
for everything is through Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who is the root of daas,
and was the teacher of the generation of the wilderness,
who are called the Generation of Knowledge
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה חֻקַּת יט, ג)
And he caused to shine in Yisrael
that they merit eating in holiness,
which is "Wisdom gives life to its possessors."
And through him Yisrael can merit
וְכֵן עַל שֻׁלְחָן הַטָּהוֹר וְגוֹ׳ (שָׁם, ו)
and likewise "On the pure Table, etc." (Vayikra 24:6):
"And he shall purify it and sanctify it"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ יְרוּשַׁלְמִי שְׁקָלִים פֶּרֶק ג הֲלָכָה ג)
and then they can merit the holiness continually;
for the bread lay on the Table
And this is why these sections come
after the section of Shabbos and festivals.
